# Integrated harvest simulation v0 — SIMULATED

> Perception (synthetic images) -> maturity decision -> harvest state machine with a kinematic gantry and a geometric fork-capture model. **Cutting and plant damage are not simulated**; a seated, armed cut counts as harvested. Numbers describe the simulator, not a robot.

- Commit `4156786`, seed 20261116, 150 near-harvest trays, 30 held-out test trays
- Harvest attempts (plants predicted harvest-ready with P >= 0.6): 32; of these truly harvest-ready: 28 (88%); harvest-ready plants present in the test trays: 96
- The same plants are attempted under every strategy, so the table isolates localisation, gating and capture width. Maturity errors are identical across rows.

## Reading

- A blind cut is the failure that matters: the blade closes on leaves or on nothing. The stem-seated sensor converts every blind cut into a harmless miss by construction; what the simulation adds is how often that happens and what a retry recovers.
- Capture width and target accuracy substitute for each other. The selected fork (25 mm usable half-width) is the row to compare with narrower, blade-only tools.
- Cycle times come from motion limits and fixed allowances.
